SELECT kind,identity,definition FROM (
 SELECT 'relation'::text kind,c.relname identity,concat_ws('|',c.relkind::text,pg_get_userbyid(c.relowner),c.relrowsecurity::text,c.relforcerowsecurity::text) definition FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relkind IN ('r','p','v','S')
 UNION ALL SELECT 'column',c.relname||'.'||a.attname,concat_ws('|',a.attnum::text,format_type(a.atttypid,a.atttypmod),a.attnotnull::text,a.attidentity::text,coalesce(pg_get_expr(d.adbin,d.adrelid),'')) FROM pg_attribute a JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=a.attrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON d.adrelid=c.oid AND d.adnum=a.attnum WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND a.attnum>0 AND NOT a.attisdropped
 UNION ALL SELECT 'constraint',c.relname||'.'||k.conname,pg_get_constraintdef(k.oid,true) FROM pg_constraint k JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=k.conrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1
 UNION ALL SELECT 'index',c.relname,pg_get_indexdef(c.oid) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relkind='i'
 UNION ALL SELECT 'trigger',c.relname||'.'||t.tgname,pg_get_triggerdef(t.oid,true) FROM pg_trigger t JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=t.tgrelid JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND NOT t.tgisinternal
 UNION ALL SELECT 'function',p.proname||'('||pg_get_function_identity_arguments(p.oid)||')',pg_get_functiondef(p.oid)||'|'||pg_get_userbyid(p.proowner) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1
 UNION ALL SELECT 'view',c.relname,pg_get_viewdef(c.oid,true) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname=$1 AND c.relkind='v'
 ) catalog ORDER BY kind,identity,definition

INSERT INTO "chat".delivery_outbox(event_id,schema_version,subject,payload_hash,envelope) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5) ON CONFLICT(event_id) DO NOTHING
SELECT subject,envelope FROM "chat".delivery_outbox WHERE event_id=$1

WITH picked AS (SELECT event_id FROM "chat".delivery_outbox WHERE state='pending' AND available_at<=clock_timestamp() AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until<=clock_timestamp()) ORDER BY created_at,event_id FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED LIMIT $1)
 UPDATE "chat".delivery_outbox o SET lease_expiry_count=o.lease_expiry_count+CASE WHEN o.lease_until<=clock_timestamp() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END,claimed_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_owner=$2,lease_until=clock_timestamp()+($3::bigint*interval '1 millisecond'),fence=o.fence+1,attempts=o.attempts+1 FROM picked WHERE o.event_id=picked.event_id RETURNING o.event_id,o.subject,o.envelope,o.fence,o.attempts

UPDATE "chat".delivery_outbox SET acknowledgement_latency_ms=GREATEST(0,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (clock_timestamp()-claimed_at))*1000)::bigint,state='published',broker_stream=$4,broker_sequence=$5,published_at=clock_timestamp(),lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,failure_class=NULL WHERE event_id=$1 AND lease_owner=$2 AND fence=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND state='pending'

UPDATE "chat".delivery_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN attempts >= $4 OR $5 <> 'transient' THEN 'quarantined' ELSE 'pending' END,failure_class=$5,available_at=clock_timestamp()+($6::bigint*interval '1 millisecond'),lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL WHERE event_id=$1 AND lease_owner=$2 AND fence=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND state='pending'

UPDATE "chat".delivery_outbox SET state=CASE WHEN attempts>$4 THEN 'quarantined' ELSE state END,failure_class=CASE WHEN attempts>$4 THEN 'transient' ELSE failure_class END,lease_owner=CASE WHEN attempts>$4 THEN NULL ELSE lease_owner END,lease_until=CASE WHEN attempts>$4 THEN NULL ELSE lease_until END WHERE event_id=$1 AND lease_owner=$2 AND fence=$3 AND lease_until>clock_timestamp() AND state='pending' RETURNING attempts>$4
INSERT INTO "chat".delivery_inbox(consumer_id,projection_generation,event_id,envelope_hash) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
SELECT envelope_hash FROM "chat".delivery_inbox WHERE consumer_id=$1 AND projection_generation=$2 AND event_id=$3
INSERT INTO "chat".delivery_quarantine(consumer_id,projection_generation,envelope_hash,subject,envelope,failure_class) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
SELECT subject,envelope,failure_class FROM "chat".delivery_quarantine WHERE consumer_id=$1 AND projection_generation=$2 AND envelope_hash=$3

SELECT count(*) FILTER(WHERE state='pending'),

 COALESCE(sum(lease_expiry_count),0)::bigint,
 COALESCE(max(acknowledgement_latency_ms),0)::bigint FROM "chat".delivery_outbox
